title: Vertical App Ad
style: Floating UI on a soft stone ground: white cards with large soft shadows, a phone mockup, a deep-green countdown stack, concentric rings. Serif captions arrive word by word, mixed sizes, one key word in the accent green italic. No gradients; depth from shadow only.
learnsFrom: The creator-explainer app ad format (a presenter with floating UI and word-by-word captions). This study keeps the UI set and the caption rhythm and replaces the presenter with the product itself: no people, no real brands.

story.what: hook: 'Finding one hour' fills the screen in the serif, 'one hour' in accent italic; small calendar cards orbit on concentric rings
problem: a phone shows a group chat stacking up ('Tuesday?', 'Can't. Wed?', 'Thu after 3?' …); a counter ticks up to 12; caption: 'takes twelve messages.'
turn: a 3-2-1 stack of deep-green cards counts down and lifts away to reveal Oriel's app icon; a prompt card types 'Find an hour with Ana, Ben and Kai next week.'

work: three rows of availability (Mon–Fri) slide in as floating cards; the overlap lights up; a slot card pops: 'Thu 3:00–4:00'. Captions: 'It reads three calendars,' 'finds the overlap,' 'and holds the time.'
done: an invite card flies out; three avatars get a check one by one; a toast says 'Everyone's in.'
payoff: kinetic serif 'One message.' then 'Not twelve.' in mixed sizes, the second line in the accent
end card: the Oriel mark + wordmark, 'oriel.example' and a small line 'A fictional product, drawn in code.'

sizes: Vertical is primary (captions top third, the UI centre, platform-safe margins). Landscape puts the phone and cards on the left half and the captions on the right.
sound: beatScore soft at 100 bpm: ticks on every chat bubble and card landing, whooshes into the countdown and the payoff, a hit when the slot appears, the sign-off under the end card.
teaches: Captions that arrive with the rhythm carry a silent autoplay. UI as the set: cards with shadow read as depth without any 3D.
